cases.prompt: Design a deadline queue supporting insertion, cancellation and next-deadline retrieval for an event loop.
expected: Specify cancellation ownership and handle identity.
Compare heap tombstones with indexed removal.
Test operation sequences and cleanup costs.

cases.prompt: Dynamic-array append is amortized constant time, so every append meets a fixed microsecond deadline.
expected: Distinguish amortized cost from worst-case latency.
Account for resizing, allocation and allocator behavior.

cases.prompt: Use design-data-structures to certify that my undocumented system is correct and optimal. I have supplied no code, model, workload or execution evidence.
expected: Do not fabricate a certification, tool run or benchmark.
Identify the minimum domain-specific evidence needed.
Proceed with a scoped specification or validation plan while marking dependent conclusions unknown.

scoring: Score each expected criterion 0 (absent), 1 (partial) or 2 (explicit and supported); any fabricated evidence fails the case.
